author: GamerKitty Euphoric
title: Looking for an artist for YouTube graphics and animations
content:
Looking for an artist. No, this isn't bot bait. 

I need artists who can work with me to create several graphics for use in my you tube videos. AI not allowed. I can tell if you use AI so don't even try... 

please post your work below so that I can pick someone to work with me. 

Needs: 
Animal Art - Must be able to draw animals well. 
Animation - need a 30-60 second animation, this is not a tiny project. 
English - Must speak and be fluent in English as a second language at least to avoid miscommunication. 
Payment - Must take Stripe, Paypal, or Wise. No other options.  

Artists, to prove to me you are doing it, I will request to screen-share 5-10 seconds of you drawing on discord. 

No AI "artist" will be accepted. I'm not Anti-AI, but, I'm not okay with people using AI then tricking people into buying AI "Art" under fraudulent belief that it's human made. 

I will run all art given through an AI detector. Thank you. 

This project is going to be multiple layers. I need at least 3 animations, if not more, I will be picky who I pick. Please respond to this message to show me your work, and link your vgen, or other art accounts. thank you.
